notes.title: New game mode in latest update!
notes.content:
Too scared? Too helpless? Too slow while playing DAYMARE: 1998? We’ve got your back! Our new update brings a brand new game mode to help you out!
+ move faster
+ reload easily (no ammo management)
+ skip puzzles
+ two new maps for H.A.D.E.S. Dead End 
+ and more!
Now on PC! 

[previewyoutube=8rxOGs3ZPfE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: H.A.D.E.S Dead End is here in a Free content update!
notes.content:
Enter the "H.A.D.E.S Dead End" gameplay mode. A brand new mode that will challenge even the most experienced of you! 
Execute the Clean Slate protocol with Liev. Retrieve or destroy 3 key items and evacuate as fast as possible. Get time bonus for every kill, even more with combo kills! Join the hunt for the best high score!

https://youtu.be/lsqNht3Xfzo

As a bunch of fixes and updates made it into this package, we're adding a changelog:
- Added H.A.D.E.S Dead End mode
- Fixed a bug regarding Overdose Achievement
- Fixed the problem the enemies being too close to the player, on loaded Checkpoint
- General optimization on all levels
- Fixed the input bug occurring under special occasions using a controller
- Fixed the damage multiplier of shotgun special ammo
- Improved translation in all languages

notes.title: Patch 2.0 is out!
notes.content:
We’re not only squashing more bugs, but also adding new features. So please welcome “STORY MODE”! Tired of dying constantly? Choose our new difficulty mode to concentrate on the more pleasant parts of the game.

And a big bonus for our fans from China – localization in Simplified Chinese. Also, more languages are being discussed.

More next time, so stay tuned!

https://youtu.be/NYxm8akla2I

--------------------------
PATCH 2.0 CHANGELOG
Additions
- New difficulty mode added (Story/Easy Mode)
- Simplified Chinese localization added (Subs and Menu items)

Fixes/Updates
- Adjusted difficulty on some sections of the game (Normal Mode)
- Translations for all languages
- Some character animations updated and improved
- Some minor UI problems in the initial menu fixed
- Fixed a rare bug occurring at the end of "Sewers" (deleted all inventory in the next level)
- Credits not ending in the initial menu fixed
- General performance optimization
- Fixed graphic bug occurring when deleting a save game while having multiple saves
- Fixed collision problem occurring with the elevator on the Dam Entrance level
- A problem occurring in the final boss fight when shooting the explosive tanks
- Credits updated
--------------------------

notes.title: The first patch for Daymare: 1998 is here!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

The first patch for Daymare: 1998 is here!
We followed your comments and requests, so to improve the overall experience we added key binding and tweaked the level of health for some enemies.
You can expect more to come, as well as some new content that we are working on!
Check out the full changelog on Steam: 

------------------------------------------------
CHANGELOG (Revision number 9750)
- Added key binding for Mouse and Keyboard.
- Fixed cutscene not playing on ultrawide monitors.
- Fixed a problem occurring with Cloud Saves when playing on a different PC.
- Added an extra check for the "All Puppets" Achievement, which sometimes did not trigger correctly upon completion. If this problem occurs, simply enter the Extra menu from the Main menu to unlock the Achievement.
- Improved some translations.
- Lowered the amount of health of both Castors in the fight at the Outskirts.
- Fixed issue with the final boss getting stuck sometimes.
- Fixed a rare block occurring at the Hospital when opening a locker.
- Fixed a graphic problem regarding objectives not updating correctly at the hospital after loading a specific checkpoint.
- Fixed a graphic problem regarding the counter not updating correctly when shooting a Deer collectable and then loading a previous checkpoint.
- Fixed a graphic bug in the D.I.D. which occurred when selecting an Energy Bar and trying to combine it with something else.
- Doctor Weir's 2 File - code updated

notes.title: Nick Apostolides (the voice of Leon S. Kennedy in RE2 Remake) feedback of Daymare Demo
notes.content:
Nick Apostolides (the voice of Leon S. Kennedy in RE2 Remake) had a chance to try out the early demo of DAYMARE: 1998.
We suppose we can say that Leon was playing with Liev

Here is what he says about it:
"What an undertaking this must have been for a small team! Can't say enough good things about it. Overall, it was challenging just to stay alive. If you like true survival horror, you'll like this game! This game pays tribute to where it all began. Definitely check it out when it releases!"

https://youtu.be/pSkgfYGvoMQ

Daymare: 1998 will be released on PC/Steam on September 17th for 29.99 EUR/29.99 USD.
Wishlist the game and download the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/842100/Daymare_1998
